patch_description: Add a cheap, cached routing screen for a bounded set of energy-promising proposals. It routes each demand along shortest paths under three deterministic tie-breakings, then scores the candidate using both the mean and worst peak link load. The batch still reserves most of its choices for existing energy, operator, and dual-guided signals; only a size-scaled fraction is selected by the routing screen. This adds an independent signal for topologies whose apparent quality depends on how shortest-path ties are resolved, without spending extra LP calls or letting the heuristic dominate selection.
